summary:
[  edit  ]
The Sprinkle  SOP  is used to add  points  to either the surface or the volume of a  SOP . You can create points on a surface, or within a closed volume based on the Method menu. The Surface method keeps the distribution of points constant per unit area of surface, whereas Per- Primitive  gives each primitive, usually triangles, a constant number per primitive no matter their size.
The second input is used when you are scattering on a deforming surface. You generally don't want the distribution of points to jump while deforming, so you give the deformed surface as second input and the un-deformed surface as the first input. The Sprinkle  SOP  will then distribute points on the un-deformed surface, and then put them on their equivalent place on the deformed surface.

parameters.label: Seed
parameters.name: seed
parameters.description: Any number, integer or non-integer, which starts the random number generator. Each number gives completely different point positions.

parameters.label: Method
parameters.name: method
parameters.description: ⊞  - Describes where points are located.

parameters.label: Surface
parameters.name: surface
parameters.description: Points are evenly distributed along the entire surface of the geometry. That is, smaller polygons receives fewer points on average than larger polygons, etc.

parameters.label: Per  Primitive
parameters.name: perprim
parameters.description: Points are distributed equally amongst each primitive. That is, each polygon receives the same number of points.

parameters.label: Bounding Box
parameters.name: boundingbox
parameters.description: Points are distributed within the bounding box volume of the geometry. This can be faster, though less accurate than the volume method.

parameters.label: Approximate Volume
parameters.name: approxvol
parameters.description: Points are evenly distributed within an approximation of the volume. Areas close to the surface may receive fewer points.

parameters.label: Volume
parameters.name: volume
parameters.description: Points are evenly distributed within the entire volume of the geometry.

parameters.label: Number of Points
parameters.name: numpoints
parameters.description: The total number of points created.

parameters.label: Consolidate
parameters.name: consolidate
parameters.description: Remove points until remaining are a minimum distance apart.

parameters.label: Distance to Nearest  Point
parameters.name: neardist
parameters.description: Minimum distance when using Consolidate option.

parameters.label: num_points
parameters.description: Number of points in this  SOP .

parameters.label: num_prims
parameters.description: Number of primitives in this  SOP .

parameters.label: num_particles
parameters.description: Number of particles in this  SOP .

parameters.label: last_vbo_update_time
parameters.description: Time spent in another thread updating geometry data on the  GPU  from the  SOP 's CPU data. As it is part of another thread, this time is not part of the usual frame time.

parameters.label: last_meta_vbo_update_time
parameters.description: Time spent in another thread updating meta surface geometry data (such as metaballs or nurbs) on the  GPU  from the  SOP 's CPU data. As it is part of another thread, this time is not part of the usual frame time.

parameters.label: total_cooks
parameters.description: Number of times the operator has cooked since the process started.

parameters.label: cook_time
parameters.description: Duration of the last cook in milliseconds.

parameters.label: cook_frame
parameters.description: Frame number when this operator was last cooked relative to the component timeline.

parameters.label: cook_abs_frame
parameters.description: Frame number when this operator was last cooked relative to the absolute time.

parameters.label: cook_start_time
parameters.description: Time in milliseconds at which the operator started cooking in the frame it was cooked.

parameters.label: cook_end_time
parameters.description: Time in milliseconds at which the operator finished cooking in the frame it was cooked.

parameters.label: cooked_this_frame
parameters.description: 1 if operator was cooked this frame.

parameters.label: warnings
parameters.description: Number of warnings in this operator if any.

parameters.label: errors
parameters.description: Number of errors in this operator if any.
